reason: I've heard magnesium mentioned plenty, but I've never tried it and I'm not sure a gummy with sugar and glucose syrup in it is going to do much for tiredness. I'd put my name on the waitlist to see what other people say, but I wouldn't spend money on it this week.
objection: Does it actually do anything for tiredness? The label only says it 'contributes to the reduction of tiredness', and I can't tell from that whether I'd notice a difference after a month.
would_change_my_mind: Hearing from someone my age, or from my pharmacist or GP, that it has helped with tiredness and that the amount is right for me.
